scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix app
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f server/docker/docker-compose.yml down -v && npm run db:up
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n server,app -c blue,green "npm:server:dev" "npm:app:start"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix app
